nodes.name: Read Inbox Files
nodes.notes: Reads all supported files from inbox. If no files, this node outputs nothing and the workflow stops naturally. Supported types: .docx .pdf .xlsx .xls .jpg .jpeg .png

nodes.name: Move to Processing

parameters.command: python -c "import shutil,os; src=r'{{ $binary.data.filePath }}'; proc=os.environ.get('INGEST_PROCESSING_DIR','D:/AI_KB/processing'); os.makedirs(proc,exist_ok=True); dst=os.path.join(proc,os.path.basename(src)); shutil.move(src,dst); print(dst)"

nodes.notes: Moves each file from inbox to processing directory. Outputs new file path on stdout. Uses os.environ INGEST_PROCESSING_DIR.

nodes.name: Extract Text
nodes.notes: Calls extract_text.py with the processing-dir path from previous stdout. Outputs JSON: {text, metadata, ocr_used, page_count}. Supports .docx, .pdf (text+scan), .xlsx/.xls, images (OCR).

nodes.name: Chunk Text

parameters.command: python -c "import subprocess,sys,os; txt=open(r'{{ $json._tmp_text }}',encoding='utf-8').read(); r=subprocess.run(['python','scripts/chunk_text.py','--chunk-size','800','--overlap','150','--text',txt],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',cwd=os.environ.get('PROJECT_ROOT','.')); sys.stdout.buffer.write(r.stdout.encode('utf-8') if r.stdout else b''); sys.exit(r.returncode)"

nodes.notes: Reads extracted text from temp file and calls chunk_text.py. Uses a Python wrapper to safely pass text as subprocess argument, avoiding shell escaping issues. chunk-size=800, overlap=150.

nodes.name: Embed Chunks

parameters.command: python -c "import subprocess,sys,os; r=subprocess.run(['python','scripts/embed_chunks.py'],stdin=open(r'{{ $json._tmp_chunks }}',encoding='utf-8'),capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',cwd=os.environ.get('PROJECT_ROOT','.')); sys.stdout.buffer.write(r.stdout.encode('utf-8') if r.stdout else b''); sys.exit(r.returncode)"

nodes.notes: Calls embed_chunks.py with chunks JSON piped via stdin from temp file. embed_chunks.py reads JSON array from stdin, calls Ollama /api/embeddings for each chunk, and outputs updated array with 'embedding' fields. Uses OLLAMA_BASE_URL and OLLAMA_EMBED_MODEL env vars.

nodes.name: Write to DB

parameters.command: python -c "import subprocess,sys,os; r=subprocess.run(['python','scripts/write_to_db.py'],stdin=open(r'{{ $json._tmp_payload }}',encoding='utf-8'),capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',cwd=os.environ.get('PROJECT_ROOT','.')); sys.stdout.buffer.write(r.stdout.encode('utf-8') if r.stdout else b''); sys.exit(r.returncode)"

nodes.notes: Calls write_to_db.py with full payload (text+metadata+embedded chunks) piped via stdin. write_to_db.py handles deduplication internally via SHA-256 hash check. Outputs JSON status: {status: 'ok'|'skipped'|'error', ...}. PostgreSQL connection uses POSTGRES_* env vars.

nodes.name: Check Success
nodes.notes: Routes to 'Move to Processed' (true) if write_to_db.py exited with code 0 (ok or skipped). Routes to 'Move to Error' (false) on non-zero exit. Status 'skipped' (duplicate file) also goes to processed.

nodes.name: Move to Processed

parameters.command: python -c "import shutil,os; src=r'{{ $json.metadata.file_path }}'; proc=os.environ.get('INGEST_PROCESSED_DIR','D:/AI_KB/processed'); os.makedirs(proc,exist_ok=True); dst=os.path.join(proc,os.path.basename(src)); shutil.move(src,dst); print(dst)"

nodes.notes: Moves successfully processed file from processing/ to processed/ directory. metadata.file_path contains the processing-dir path set by extract_text.py.

nodes.name: Move to Error

parameters.command: python -c "import shutil,os; src=r'{{ $json.metadata.file_path if $json.metadata else ($json.stdout or '').strip() }}'; err_dir=os.environ.get('INGEST_ERROR_DIR','D:/AI_KB/error'); os.makedirs(err_dir,exist_ok=True); dst=os.path.join(err_dir,os.path.basename(src)) if src else ''; shutil.move(src,dst) if src and os.path.exists(src) else None; print(dst or 'no-file')"

nodes.notes: Moves failed file from processing/ to error/ directory. Handles cases where metadata may not be fully populated (early-stage failures).

environment_variables: PROJECT_ROOT  — absolute path to this repo (e.g. D:/n8n/CLAUDE 實做/本地AI企業問答助理)
import_instructions: 1. In n8n UI: Workflows → Import from File → select this JSON
2. Set environment variables in n8n Settings > Variables (or via .env / system env)
3. Ensure PROJECT_ROOT points to the repo root so scripts/ can be found
4. Activate the workflow to start polling every 1 minute
5. Drop files into INGEST_INBOX_DIR to trigger processing
_comments.deduplication_note: Deduplication is handled entirely inside write_to_db.py via SHA-256 hash lookup in the documents table. Duplicate files exit with code 0 and status='skipped', which routes them to processed/ (not error/).
_comments.error_handling_note: Each Execute Command node has continueOnFail:true. The Check Success IF node routes on exitCode===0. For failures in the middle of the pipeline (Extract/Chunk/Embed), the Code nodes throw exceptions which propagate and will trigger n8n's built-in error workflow if configured in settings.errorWorkflow.
_comments.windows_path_note: Commands use Python's subprocess module and raw string literals (r'...') for Windows path compatibility. The workflow was designed for Windows but should work on Linux/Mac with the same env var values using forward-slash paths.
